verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only internal classification: transaction categories, cost centers and suppliers (docs-6, docs-7, docs-8). It also shows a public API for reconciling transactions and pulling statements. None of it mentions a native sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite or Xero, or user-controlled mappings to GL accounts, classes or departments. Internal categorization and API building blocks are adjacent features or developer primitives, not the accounting-sync capability itself.
